about_the_game:
4 Crystals keeps village alive Can you protect them ?

  • In Dwarven Village, you should protect to protect the crystals from the attacks of orcs. you need to place dwarfs & towers and make tactical decisions, You also need to work on the village and make buildings & repair damaged buildings to stand more in the game

  • There is a stat named "Night Chance" that for calculating if the next wave is night or not, if it is, the orc masters are able to spawn, enemies are faster their cooldown is less and it is hard to protect the crystals, as this stat will increase over time you are able to reduce it as this is the worst stat.

PLACEMENT

  • You are able to place dwarfs on the paths and buildings on the sides of paths

LEVELS

  • Dwarfs level up automatically, enemies level up by wave and you need to upgrade your buildings to get more resources 

VILLAGE

  • You need to work on the "Dwarven Village" by placing & repairing & upgrading towers to get bonus stats & spells

GETTING HELP FROM DIFFERENT RACES

  • When you repair the watchtower in the village you are able to select one race and get help from them by being able to place them on paths & being able to place special towers that belongs to that race.

INCREASE YOUR STATS BY BUYING & UPGRADING TOWERS 

  • You can increase your stats by buying & upgrading towers & statues  or with cards
